/PATCHSET_LEVEL.author: Shaobo Yan
/PATCHSET_LEVEL.message: PTAL, this fix a cts validation test failure. The failure is due to we report exceed maxImmediateSize during shaderModule creation time instead of pipeline creation time.

src/dawn/native/ShaderModule.cpp.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/native/ShaderModule.cpp.message: We can just use `DelayedInvalidIf` which is designed to handle pushing errors to pipeline creation time (when we detect them at shader creation time). So we don't need the complexity of an overflow bit etc.
